dataset: OpenNeuro ds000114 v1.0.2; FNIT defaced public T1w examples

timing_scope.full_process: Fresh full official CLI or one full FNIT API worker; process start, imports, read, complete calculation and save
timing_scope.main: One complete warmup pair excluded, then three alternating AB/BA pairs; median of three
timing_scope.loaded_api: One full warmup excluded, then three complete read/calculate/save API calls; excludes interpreter and Torch/adapter setup
timing_scope.functions: One complete pair per case/thread budget; no warmup, no stable speed estimate
timing_scope.threads: Same allowed physical cores and thread ceilings; actual process CPU usage reported separately
timing_scope.phases: FNIT phase diagnostics only; default native CLI does not supply equivalent phase clocks

precision: Float32 images/coordinates/ordered statistics; float64 matrix construction and NMI histogram; unchanged search/iteration budgets
